verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the self-hosted Edge Proxy, which runs an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers and accepts connections from server-side SDKs. That cuts latency but still implies a network hop to the proxy, not in-process evaluation. A community comment also notes Flagsmith 'apparently does primarily server-side eval', and no evidence documents an in-process SDK local-evaluation mode. Missing for 10: documented in-process local evaluation in the server SDKs, cached ruleset/environment document polling or refresh, evidence of no network call per flag check, and microsecond-latency benchmarks or hands-on corroboration.
